verdict.rationale: Automatic image captioning is a fair extraction-quality question for a scraping API, but the evidence pack never documents ScrapingBee generating captions or alt-text descriptions for page images. The nearest features are different capabilities: text-based semantic extraction via `ai_query`, markdown output, screenshots, and loading images with `block_resources=false`. None of these produces image captions.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
